reason: The cited evidence (E1) only states that Mo oxide has a layered, shearable structure that helps wear resistance; it provides no support for adapting a coating approach to bulk alloys, for in situ oxidation by frictional heat, or for simultaneous friction and wear reduction across a wide temperature range. The key premises are therefore largely unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Mo oxide has a layered, easily sheared structure that promotes wear resistance
Mo addition to a coating (AlCrTiZrMox)N can be adapted to bulk high-entropy alloys
Frictional heat will oxidize Mo in situ to form a lubricious tribolayer
The Mo-oxide tribolayer will simultaneously reduce friction and wear across a wide temperature range
